column1: # OpenCode Go model choice by the kind of work (HUTCH_KIND). The first model not listed in ~/.hutch/skip wins.
# Each model has its own monthly limit (Go $10 plan, 2026-11-07), so spreading kinds spreads the budget.
# Limits: deepseek-v4.1-flash $100; glm-5.3-flash, glm-5.2, kimi-k2.7-code, qwen3.7-plus, mimo-v2.6-flash $60;
# Owner 2026-11-07: DeepSeek Pro for concurrency, race conditions and architecture; Flash for UI, scripts and
# templates. This replaces the 2026-11-05 Flash-only rule on this route. Pro's $15 limit is the smallest, so only
# concurrency and design start on it.
# small serves the agents' background calls and helper subagents, so they do not spend the main model's limit.
